scope: Reviewed call contracts, not a claim to recover unique original C declarations

abi.a2-a3,t0-t3,stack: variadic arguments according to the format

evidence: PAL 0011D920 is the resident formatted-string wrapper.
PAL 0054A5A0 supplies two string pointers and one integer; 004C3C10 supplies multiple string pointers.
func_0011D920.notes: Do not infer buffer capacity or omit later variadic arguments. No SDK implementation source is included.

func_00453F30.declaration: void func_00453F30(void *destination, const void *source, u32 bytes);
evidence: PAL 00453F30-00453FE4 copies bytes and has no meaningful return contract
PAL 0048C8C8-0048C8D8 supplies a four-byte local output before reading it
func_00453F30.notes: The destination must cover bytes; no containing structure size follows from a call alone. Do not declare a pointer return just because a scratch register happens to retain a pointer.

evidence: PAL 0045E850 forwards the identifier to 0045EB78 and returns a string address.
PAL 004C3C10 and 0054A5A0 consume the results as sprintf string arguments.
func_0045E850.notes: Const describes the reviewed read-only consumer contract; original return qualification is unknown.

abi.v0: old cursor on success, zero on failure

evidence: PAL 0048C2D0-0048C2F0 rounds bytes up to 16 and compares the advanced cursor with end
PAL 0048C8DC-0048C8FC passes cursor/end and stores the returned address
func_0048C2D0.notes: The cursor is updated even on failure. Success requires advanced_cursor < end, not <= end. Arithmetic is the target's 32-bit address arithmetic.

evidence: PAL 004999E0-004999E8 reads only record words0 and4 as lookup inputs.
PAL 004999EC-00499A18 overwrites all24 bytes from the record returned by 004FD000.
PAL 004CD748 reads result word8 only after the call.
func_004999D0.notes: The two input words must be initialized. Remaining output words need not be initialized before this call; they are completely overwritten. 004FD000 returns the first resident record on a lookup miss.

evidence: PAL 0049AA18 compares a0 with registry record word4 and calls 0049A218 with the matching record pointer.
PAL 004CCCB0 performs resource cleanup and ignores v0.
PAL 0049B418 reads and updates *a0 and consumes f12; it initializes f13 and f14 internally.
PAL 004A62F8 calls it for the context fade field.
func_0049B418.notes: Extra incoming float registers are not arguments merely because the caller left values there.

evidence: PAL 004A2798 loads the word at a0 and adds a1.
PAL 004C3C10 passes the result as a UI handle, not a pointer.
func_004A2798.notes: Handle arithmetic follows target 32-bit word behavior. This is not a pointer lookup.

evidence: PAL 004A91BC reads player+0x2F00; 004A9278 returns the angle in f0.
PAL 004A93AC-004A93B4 passes Player* and consumes f0 as f12.
func_004A91A0.notes: The pointed-to class name is descriptive; only the observed fields and pointer role are established.

abi.v0: unsigned byte direction value promoted to a word

evidence: PAL 004A9348 forwards f12 to 004A9288 with a0=32.
PAL 004A9360 loads the resulting table byte into v0.
PAL 004CD990-004CD99C calls 0054A290 then 0045E850 using the signed16 descriptor label at+0xA.
PAL 004CCEC4-004CCED4 forwards the result to the text input of 005062D0.
PAL 004CDB48-004CDB58 calls 0054A290 then 0045E850 using the signed16 descriptor label at+8.
PAL 004CCE9C-004CCEAC forwards the result to the text input of 005062D0.
PAL 004E33A0 conditionally stores a0 through a non-null a1.
PAL 004F35C4-004F35CC registers it as a completion callback.
func_004E33A0.notes: A null completion pointer suppresses the store; this callback does not construct a meaningful return value.

func_004E88B8.declaration: void func_004E88B8(s32 command, u64 value, s32 unused);
evidence: src/pal/game/004E88B8.c
PAL 0044E554-0044E590 forwards the original full-width value in both branches
func_004E88B8.notes: A 64-bit saved register alone is insufficient evidence of a 64-bit argument. Here the value is actually stored as an eight-byte packet field.

evidence: config/pal/map.tsv maps func_004E7B88 to PAL 004E8AB0
src/game/004E7B88.c
PAL direct callers ignore v0 before replacing it
func_004E8AB0.notes: A cursor left in v0 at the end is not evidence of a returned pointer. Use the existing void contract. Source names outside src/pal can be US-address aliases.

evidence: PAL 00502520 calls 00502518 with a1=0; 00502518 stores a1 at object+0.
func_00502520.notes: Concrete object class is unresolved; no returned value is consumed by reviewed callers.

evidence: src/pal/game/005062D0.c
func_005062D0.notes: The pointer is forwarded to the selected text callback. Preserve it as a pointer rather than an integer. A failed resolution or absent callback returns zero.

evidence: PAL 00506BC8-00506BF0 obtains context+0x14 or returns -1
func_00506BB8.notes: Do not assume the result is nonnegative solely because a caller uses it as an index. Check that caller's context invariant.

abi.incoming_sp+0: ninth argument; callee consumes its low unsigned byte

evidence: PAL 00507270-005072C4 saves all eight GPR arguments and reads the ninth at frame+0xB0
PAL 005073AC-005073BC passes the ninth value to the 0x200 flag setter and loads status
PAL 004D0018 stores the outgoing ninth zero before the call at 004D0020
PAL 004CA27C stores the outgoing ninth zero before the call at 004CA288
func_00507270.notes: The word-sized C ninth parameter expresses a valid calling contract; only its low byte is consumed. Exact original typedef/signedness is not established. Pass the ninth argument explicitly. An unrelated volatile local at sp+0 is not an argument.

func_00549050.declaration: void func_00549050(const char *text, s32 slot, s32 duration);
evidence: PAL 0054905C-0054906C rejects null text, nonpositive duration and negative slot.
PAL 005490C0-005490E4 computes a duration and copies the string to a resident message buffer.
PAL 0054A5A0 and src/pal/game/0054AFA0.c pass a real stack character buffer.
func_00549050.notes: The callee copies text during the call; it does not retain the caller stack pointer.

evidence: PAL 0049902C-00499040 loads hero inventory at+0x26E4, checks it, and supplies the item.
PAL 00499044-00499068 compares the level and formats level+1.
func_005492C0.notes: The callee obtains a signed 16-bit level. A physical pointer argument must not be replaced by an item identifier.

evidence: PAL 0054A2A8-0054A2B4 and 0054A2BC-0054A2C8 both compute 003DF190 + item*0xB0.
PAL 0054A5A0 reads a signed text identifier at descriptor+8; 004CD748 reads an unsigned identifier at+0x36.
func_0054A290.notes: The second argument has no address effect in this resident implementation. Descriptor class, original pointer typedef and total object extent are not inferred from these field accesses.

evidence: PAL 0054A308-0054A320 clamps the signed index.
PAL 0054A324-0054A338 reads byte config+index*0x44+0xA30, toggles bit7, then shifts right7.
func_0054A308.notes: The Boolean result reports that bit7 was clear. Exact original Boolean typedef is unresolved.
